## `/fundadmin:fund check-compliance <file>` {#check-compliance}

Compliance evidence-gap review (FATCA/CRS/AML/ERISA)

Reviews a document for evidence gaps against FATCA, CRS, AML/KYC, ERISA, Form PF/D/ADV, AIFMD and SFDR requirements; document language is not operational compliance. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund check-compliance`, asks for a compliance gap check, or shares an LPA or PPM.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund check-compliance <file>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-check-compliance <file>` |
| Codex | `$fund-check-compliance <file>` |

**Writes** `COMPLIANCE-REVIEW-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-check-compliance/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund kyc-review <file>` {#kyc-review}

KYC/AML file review, routed by the firm's rules grid

Reviews one investor KYC/AML package: extracts a structured record, applies the firm's rules grid and routes it to request documents, escalate for EDD or hold, with collection completeness out of 100. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund kyc-review` or shares a KYC package.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund kyc-review <file>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-kyc-review <file>` |
| Codex | `$fund-kyc-review <file>` |

**Writes** `KYC-REVIEW-[fund]-[investor]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-kyc-review/SKILL.md)

## `/fundadmin:fund regulatory-filing <type>` {#regulatory-filing}

Filing draft prep (Form PF/D/ADV) — no submission

Prepares a filing draft for Form PF/D/ADV, 13F/13H, FATCA/CRS or FBAR: extracts required data points, scores completeness and flags gaps against the deadline; no submission or certification. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund regulatory-filing` or asks to prepare a filing.
